# Get file sizes
ACCESS_SIZE=$(stat -c%s /var/log/samples/access.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
APP_SIZE=$(stat -c%s /var/log/samples/app.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
SYSTEM_SIZE=$(stat -c%s /var/log/samples/system.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
ERROR_SIZE=$(stat -c%s /var/log/samples/error.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
DEBUG_SIZE=$(stat -c%s /var/log/samples/debug.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

# Convert to MB
ACCESS_MB=$(echo "scale=2; $ACCESS_SIZE / 1048576" | bc)
APP_MB=$(echo "scale=2; $APP_SIZE / 1048576" | bc)
SYSTEM_MB=$(echo "scale=2; $SYSTEM_SIZE / 1048576" | bc)
ERROR_MB=$(echo "scale=2; $ERROR_SIZE / 1048576" | bc)
DEBUG_MB=$(echo "scale=2; $DEBUG_SIZE / 1048576" | bc)

TOTAL_MB=$(echo "scale=2; $ACCESS_MB + $APP_MB + $SYSTEM_MB + $ERROR_MB + $DEBUG_MB" | bc)
SAVINGS_MB=$(echo "scale=2; $TOTAL_MB * 0.35" | bc)

echo "ACCESS_MB=$ACCESS_MB APP_MB=$APP_MB SYSTEM_MB=$SYSTEM_MB ERROR_MB=$ERROR_MB DEBUG_MB=$DEBUG_MB TOTAL=$TOTAL_MB SAVINGS=$SAVINGS_MB"
